editorial:
Imagine being treated like a monster your whole life until you finally decide to become one. You follow a man named Iguana, a sailor with a scary face who gets bullied and beaten by his crew on a whaling ship. After he has had enough, he runs away to a lonely island where he can finally be the boss. The vibe is very tense and lonely, making you feel how much pain he is in while he turns his sadness into a mean streak. He treats anyone who lands on his beach like a prisoner, turning the island into his own little kingdom of fear.

What really works here is the acting and the way the movie builds a creepy mood. The pacing is slow, which might bore some people, but it makes the scary moments hit harder. You will love the strange characters and the raw emotion, though some parts feel a bit too long. If you like weird, dark stories, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: The story ends when the cycle of hate finally catches up to Iguana. After ruling the island through fear and hurting others, he finds that he cannot actually escape his own misery. The final scenes show that his war against mankind was a losing battle. He ends up alone and broken, proving that being a tyrant didn't fix his heart. He dies in a way that shows the sadness of his wasted life.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark character studies and stories about revenge.
